Name: Murder Mod
Author: flare20012
Description:
Allows for the murder of NPCS, including modded NPCs. Dead NPCs will not move, speak, or do anything. All NPCs revive at the beginning of a season, or their names can be deleted from "dead.txt" to revive them. 

Features:
- Murder (can use sword, dagger, or club)

This is version 1.0, so expect some bugs. However, this mod shouldn't mess with your save file, so deleting the mod will revert all changes. 
Also, striking the NPCs with a weapon without talking to them is surprisingly finnicky, so beware you may have to do some maneuvering to hunt them down.
